Michael randomly samples $$3$$ observations and fits a least squares linear regression model to the sampled observations:

$$\hat{y}=	heta_0+	heta_{1}	ext{temperature}$$

The three data points and the fitted least squares line are plotted below. What is the MSE of the fitted model?

Note: You do not need to simplify algebra. PrairieLearn does not recognize decimals so all non-integers must be written as fractions.##figure1.gif##
